dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Linear, gradual narrowing of the visible body mass from the anterior-midsection toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey pigmentation across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse patches of slightly darker grey pigmentation visible on the mid-dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between localized darker grey patches and the primary baseline skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast, dark circular mark on the anterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, light-colored linear marks/striations visible on the left lateral portion of the dorsal plane.
